about_the_game:
THE STORY

WARNING 18+: You are a professional basketball player who suffers a career-ending injury. So, now, you have to find a new calling, and that's when your former college comes calling for you to coach their girls' basketball team. You're still trying to get used to your new life when your ex whom you impregnated during a brief separation with your wife returns to the city. And that causes some tension, obviously. Safe to say, your life is going to get a lot more hectic from here on out.

THE GAME PLAY

You play as the main character and take control of all the decision-making, such as deciding to be stricter on a character or be more understanding. You have full control of how you play, and which characters you'll be spending time with. But be careful! Rejecting to spend time with a character or choosing the wrong choices may disable you from their route, and all future content with them because most choices have hidden points that you gain or lose!

***A free in-game walkthrough is also included for those who have trouble with selecting the correct choices, or for players who want to access every scene!***

FEATURES

- Name your own characters

- Define the relationship within the game

- Select choices that shape the story you want

- Replay the game and choose different choices to access all content

- Colorful collection of music while you play

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains age-restricted content solely intended for legal adults 18 years and older. The characters, story, and actions are fictitious. All characters are depicted as 18 and over. Contains nudity, graphic depictions of oral, vaginal and other sexual acts.
